meta.name: VisionQuest
meta.description: Başına konulan ödül yüzünden Vision, hayatta kalabilmek için kendi doğasıyla yüzleşmeli ve Ultron’un etkisine direnmelidir.

videos.name: No Strings
videos.overview: Vision is living in Edinburgh, working at a local bar. His peaceful existence is interrupted when a bounty is placed on his head. Meanwhile, a mysterious grifter named Tommy Shepherd is troubled by disturbing memories of Westview.
videos.description: Vision is living in Edinburgh, working at a local bar. His peaceful existence is interrupted when a bounty is placed on his head. Meanwhile, a mysterious grifter named Tommy Shepherd is troubled by disturbing memories of Westview.

videos.name: Theseus
videos.overview: Vision, who is still being hunted by a mysterious force, learns of Tommy's existence and begins to question if this boy is truly his son. Vision returns to the remains of the bar in Edinburgh, and comes face to face with his unknown assailant.
